songs.title: 그날도 오늘 같았죠
songs.sp: Musical theatre duet. A husband and wife stand on a warm-lit stage, trading spoken lines that melt into song. His voice: low and chest-resonant, ringing forward projection that carries to the back row, crisp consonants, long sustained note endings blooming into a slow wide vibrato, unforced power on the high held notes. Her voice: bright and head-resonant, floating above him with silvery sustained high notes, full and effortless at the top. They alternate short phrases in quick call-and-response, drift apart, then lock into tight unison as the ensemble swells. Sweeping strings, bold brass fanfares, timpani rolls, grand piano. Spoken dialogue sits dry and close; sung scenes open into deep hall reverb - the room grows with the story. Hushed intimate exchange, then full-stage blaze. Celebratory, heartfelt. 82 BPM, D Major, 4/4 time signature.

songs.title: 그대 이름 하나만
songs.sp: Korean ballad duet. Two voices at a piano in a small midnight room, sung almost at a whisper into close microphones - every breath audible, air on the consonants, warm low-mid resonance. Trained voices singing quietly: effortless steady pitch, deep breath support under every phrase, rounded open vowels even at low volume. The man sings first - soft supported chest voice, gentle legato lines that taper into breath at phrase ends. The woman answers - clear and tender, a fine controlled vibrato blooming only on the longest notes. In the chorus they join quietly, her line floating just above his. Solo grand piano and a single cello carry the verses; strings rise slowly from the second chorus, soft brushed drums enter late. The bridge sinks to near-spoken half-breath, then the final chorus opens wide and soars, both voices full, sustained, unstrained. Sincere, devoted, tearful. 64 BPM, C Major, 4/4 time signature.

songs.title: 모든 것이 은혜였죠
songs.sp: Gospel duet with full choir. A joyful service in a wooden-floored church: hand claps and tambourine on the backbeat, warm organ swelling under piano and round electric bass. The man leads with a grainy, powerful soul voice - short punchy phrases, expressive slides and ad-libs. The woman answers with bright open-throated power, melismatic runs climbing at phrase ends. Not operatic - gospel soul delivery, chest-driven, raw and warm. The choir echoes every refrain line behind the leads, thick stacked harmonies filling the room. A vamp section builds call-and-response between leads and choir, claps doubling the pulse. The final chorus lifts with a key change, choir at full spread, ending with leads and choir trading lines over sustained organ. Joyful, grateful, uplifting. 92 BPM, E-flat Major, 12/8 time signature.

장르분화_판별: 장르명 제거 후 SP 상호 대조 — 뮤지컬(spoken scenes·brass fanfares·timpani·scene changes·82BPM) / 발라드(breathy·close-mic·solo piano+cello·점층·64BPM) / 가스펠(choir echoes·vamp·hand claps·12/8·92BPM) — 발성·구조·편성·리듬·템포 전층 상이, 상호 구분 성립. operatic 태그=전곡 미사용(VD01 판정: 발성 문장 독립 기여 미검출·프레임 주도 — 분화를 프레임·편성으로 구현).
가사_차이_비율: 곡별 총행 대비 공통(코어12+확장4=16행): 뮤지컬 16/33=48% 공통 / 발라드 16/32=50% / 가스펠 16/40=40% — '차이 절반 가까이' 충족.
잠금검증: 코어 12행=3곡 전부 정본 원문 무변경. (남)/(여) 표기 유지(VD01 ㉰ 누출 0/6 확정으로 안전). 어댑터는 코어 앞뒤·사이에만.
